_comment: Hard-evidence pairing findings that must survive a re-render.
data/review_crops/pairing.json is gitignored, so a finding recorded only
in that manifest is lost the next time render_review_crops.py runs. Each
entry here forces a crop to unverified no matter what the text score says.
Source of truth for the evidence and method: logs/batch456_pairing_audit.md.
Only add a crop here when its OCR was compared against EVERY line on its
own page and another line won by a clear margin. A low text score alone is
NOT sufficient and must not be used as grounds for an entry: scores below
0.45 overlap heavily with correctly paired crops, so the renderer already
handles those on its own floor.

p111_14.png.evidence: own cl11 scores 0.00 against the crop; cl10 matches at 0.67
p111_14.png.note: Escapes the 0.45 text floor with a 0.60 guess-vs-band score, so only the page-wide comparison catches it. Needs a human or a vision model to re-crop at the correct band.
